newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BIB leads active Bahrain bourse to new high.
newsitem.headline: BIB leads active Bahrain bourse to new high.

text.p: Led by strong demand for heavyweight Bahrain International Bank (BIB), shares on the Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) moved higher in brisk trade on Tuesday, pushing the index into record territory, brokers said.
BSE figures show the index climbed 25.58 points -- or almost two percent -- to a record 1,419.54 points, after rising 6.77 points on Monday.
Turnover jumped to 5.82 million shares worth 1.1 million dinars ($2.9 million) in 77 transactions, up from 2.7 million shares worth 401,616 dinars on Monday.
Heightened trading activity began last week and traders said on Tuesday they expected the trend to continue.
"I think higher trading volume on the bourse will continue in the next few days amid investor confidence in Bahrain's economy," one said.
On Tuesday more than 4.2 million BIB shares changed hands, up from 2.1 million shares on Monday.
The share price of BIB, also traded on the Kuwaiti bourse, closed on the BSE on Tuesday at 137 fils -- up nine fils on the day and up from 109 fils on Sunday.
"BIB shares have been undervalued. Now the market is witnessing a price correction," a Bahraini broker said.
"There has been a substantial volume increase in trading in both Kuwait and Bahrain for over a week," said BIB assistant director of marketing Abdul-Razak Jawahery.
He said 14 million BIB shares, representing two percent of capital, were traded on Kuwait's stock exchange on October 5.
"There has been a substantial upsurge in trading in the bank's shares listed on the BSE too," Jawahery said.

"BIB is...listed in both Kuwait and Bahrain, and we believe the benefits of such cross-listing, where confidence in one exchange can spread easily to another, has been seen clearly in this case. It is clear that this is the result of a big upsurge of business confidence in Kuwait and Bahrain," he said.
Jawahery said BIB closed on Tuesday in Kuwait at 116 Kuwaiti fils from 89 fils per share on Sunday.
